integrity: Model-specific analytic limit and a separate comparison with the prior RAF transition. Finite diagnostics do not certify infinite limits. No formal proof verification, external attestation, or empirical validation is claimed.
limitations: Independent Pareto activity, ordered forward ligations on abstract words, fixed food length, and diffuse reaction-independent compatibility. The logarithmically shifted window is for first catalytic incidences, not RAF existence. Only the known RAF zero-one criteria are used for the RAF scale.
title: A Sibuya burst law for the first short incidences in Pareto autocatalysis
